slides.title: HVAC owner urges, furnace season edition:

slides.label: the urge to
slides.title: rename 'COI final FINAL (2).pdf' to what it actually is.

slides.label: the urge to
slides.title: tape the license expiration date to the van dashboard.
slides.body: right next to the parking tickets.

slides.label: the urge to
slides.title: ignore the 'your policy renews soon' email because 9 no-heat calls just came in.
slides.body: it'll still be there tomorrow. so will the calls.

slides.label: the urge to
slides.title: ask the new tech if his certification card is current or just laminated.

slides.label: the urge to
slides.title: check the license date one more time.

slides.label: verdict
slides.title: giving in to the last one is the only healthy urge here.
slides.body: send this to whoever holds the paperwork.
